name: shinobi-immortals-sdk-js-tests
description: Packages used only by the tests of the Shinobi Immortals Javascript SDK (test_kit.js, test_rpc.js, and test_wallet.js).  sdk/js/shinobi_immortals_base.js itself has no dependencies; sdk/js/shinobi_immortals.js uses @solana/kit.  Install with: npm ci
